'''Ad Reward Boost''' ---- Upon triumphing a match, an additional option to watch an ad for bonus rewards can appear. These are '''Ad Reward Boosts'''.
==Mechanics== [[File:AdRewardBoost.png|200px|thumb]] After triumphing a match, there is a chance for an additional button next to ''Return to Lobby'' to appear. It is a green button with "''Watch an ad for 50 coins!''" written on it. This can happen on any platform. When pressed, an ad that is a few seconds long will appear. The added reward is always {{Coins|50}}, regardless of the mode. Any modifiers present on the map will not increase the currency gotten. For example, a map with [[All Paths]] will not give {{Coins|55}} upon watching the ad. Once the ad is finished, the {{Coins|50}} will be added to the triumph screen. This will also create two pop ups, one informing the player of them getting the {{Coins|50}} and another telling them that they redeemed the Enhance Reward [[Developer Products|Developer Product]]. The ads that play will most of the time be Roblox advertisements, promoting commodities such as Roblox gift cards or other Roblox games. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| Watch an ad for 50 coins!|Video showcase AdRewardBoostIcon.png|Icon }} {{BrowseNavBox}} [[Category:Features]]
